snippet.title: The Alters: Last Variable | DLC Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The #LastVariable is coming. The new DLC for #TheAlters hits PC and consoles on July 13th 🧑‍🚀

🩵Wishlist now: https://re.11bits.com/i93 
💜Get #TheAlters Deluxe Edition for 31% off on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54533/The_Alters_Deluxe_Edition

Dive into a robust 20-hour expansion and return to the scorched planet. To unlock the mystery of the Oasis, you’ll need to master new terraforming mechanics to reshape the surface and command a specialized team of Jan Scientists... but remember, even though they look like you, they don’t always think like you...
